ownership.editor: owns selected body, actual avatar entity, model placement and action selection
ownership.engine: samples the placed animated instance once after mixer update; sampled anchors are the runtime authority
ownership.cloth: consumes this attachment descriptor and frame, supplies fitted profile/material/quality; does not run a separate skeleton sampler in gameplay
ownership.migration: LeftShoulder/RightShoulder zero-offset draft is superseded for this candidate; no silent alias or mixing with UpperArm points

coordinates.root: rigid world position and normalized quaternion [x,y,z,w]; solver and cloth mesh use world coordinates
coordinates.offsetM: physical meters in animated bone orientation; use normalized bone world quaternion, never raw armature scale
coordinates.rootLocalPins: inverse(root rigid world matrix) * bone world anchor; world pin = root rigid world matrix * rootLocalPin
coordinates.skinScale: glTF hierarchy already consumes Armature 0.0086; never multiply again

bounds.precision: measured attachment accuracy applies to the tested near-origin scene; no large-world millimetre precision claim

offsetFitStatus: rearward 25mm candidate, physical attachment/contact fitting awaits cloth and editor joint review
order: sample both bone anchors and proxy transforms
update existing zero-mass vertices and kinematic proxies
history: root/bone motion keeps body ID, free-vertex positions, previous positions and velocities; no whole-cloth rigid teleport
rebuild: attachment descriptors or explicit generation changes
failure: remove native panel and render mesh with bounded warning; no stale frozen cape; retry after next valid frame

lowFrameRate.excessTime: discard with clampedFrames diagnostic; do not replay unbounded catch-up
lowFrameRate.pins: interpolate previous/current sampled anchor per substep

colliders.axis: capsule local Y follows sampled bone orientation
